text: The foundation of guidance is following revelation and the understanding of the early generations.
Iman is statement and action, and it increases and decreases.

reference: Imam Ahmad ibn Hanbal - Usul al-Sunnah
text: Among the foundations of the Sunnah is that iman is statement and action, it increases and decreases.
Iman includes speech of the heart and tongue, and actions of the heart and limbs.
